purpose: Class-demo release d2: random image-level 80/10/10 split. Recordings cut into runs of 12 consecutive frames; fixed cameras (near-identical frames all day) kept whole; cross-source duplicates kept together; runs assigned by seeded balancing so each class/source spreads over val and test. Replaces d1, whose identical-frame merge chained videos into 100-588-frame blocks.
near_duplicate_rule: Capture groups linked by a visually confirmed cross-group duplicate are merged into one split unit. Candidate pairs come from 24x24 RGB thumbnail correlation and dHash; see reports/pilot_r0/near_duplicates.json.
